findings.description: The exact-`/` test is the first statement of the decoder, before any prefix match, so an absolute-form target never reaches dispatch. Probed extras on 063b0d5e (authority disagreeing with `Host`, no `Host`, `:port` authority, userinfo) are all 400 too.
findings.title: Absolute-form request targets are answered 400 at the decoder's first-byte `/` test, so the authority never dispatches

limitations: The proxy never executes; all RCE is on the upstream host
Absolute-form findings are negatives and need nothing but a proxied prefix location
